mirror.hero.text.major: Lots of Major Arcana — a week of big turns and inner lessons. Something bigger than daily routine seems to be in play.
mirror.hero.text.cups: Cups lead the week — feelings, people close to you and how you feel around them are at the centre.
mirror.hero.text.wands: Wands lead the week — plenty of will, ideas and drive to act. Watch out for burnout.
mirror.hero.text.swords: Swords lead the week — lots of thinking, decisions and inner tension. A good moment to unload your head.
mirror.hero.text.pentacles: Pentacles lead the week — body, money and daily life. Simple routines are your anchor now.
mirror.hero.text.balanced: No suit dominates — an even week without a strong tilt to one area.
